cells.gaps: No regulation or decree applying the law, and no rule made under it that others must check identity against the system, dated in the last three years, is held.
cells.note: Rebuild 2026-10-31: The NIMC Act 2026, signed 26 June 2026, makes NIMC the biometric repository and sets a unique NIN (NGA-028); no rule made under it is held. Stage 4 holds.
